using System.Diagnostics;
// Executed by the real SDK qualification, never by Python tooling tests.
string receipt = args[0];
if (args.Length > 1)
{
    File.WriteAllText(receipt + ".child", Environment.ProcessId.ToString());
    await Task.Delay(Timeout.Infinite); return;
}
var childStart = new ProcessStartInfo(Environment.ProcessPath!);
if (Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(Environment.ProcessPath!) == "dotnet")
    childStart.ArgumentList.Add(typeof(Program).Assembly.Location);
childStart.ArgumentList.Add(receipt); childStart.ArgumentList.Add("child");
childStart.UseShellExecute = false;
using var child = Process.Start(childStart)!;
File.WriteAllText(receipt, Environment.ProcessId.ToString());
await Task.Delay(Timeout.Infinite);
